description: A supporting background-image primitive: an image anchored to any corner of the composition, sized in composition-percent, fully behind foreground content. Optional vignette dim keeps foreground legible. Designed to be paired with `layer: "background"` so it never occludes foreground/skybox content, but works at any layer.

src.description: image path relative to public/, or an http(s) URL

revealDirection.description: clip-path wipe used for the entrance reveal; 'fade' does no clip, just opacity

dim.description: opacity of the dark overlay drawn on top of the image; 0 = none, 1 = fully hidden. 0.35 reads as a muted background plate.

blurPx.description: gaussian blur on the image in px — useful for background-plate depth
